يبتنيان (form VIII)
# يَبْتَنِيَانِ (yabtaniyāni) /jab.ta.ni.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# يُبْتَنَيَانِ (yubtanayāni) /jub.ta.na.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
